title: What does AMMWithdraw do on XRPL?
abstract: Sourced explanation of AMMWithdraw and its practical limits.
body:
According to XRPL documentation, AMMWithdraw exchanges liquidity-provider tokens for assets from an AMM. [1]

Withdrawal mode controls whether the holder receives proportional assets or a requested single-asset outcome within allowed limits. Pool prices and balances affect the result, so the original deposit is not a guaranteed redemption quote. Check LP ownership and output bounds. A withdrawal changes pool exposure and can have different economics from selling LP tokens elsewhere. [1]

The AMMWithdraw reference defines the operation-specific fields alongside the shared XRPL transaction fields. Account identifies the submitting account; signing authority, transaction cost and sequence handling still have to satisfy the ledger rules. A submitted transaction or an example in documentation does not establish a successful validated result. Where an amendment is required, confirm it is enabled on the intended network before relying on the feature. [1][2]

Author interpretation: before using AMMWithdraw, compare the intended change with the current ledger state and keep the transaction hash with the resulting metadata. Treat unresolved outcomes as unresolved; submitting a replacement operation can create a second obligation. These are integration recommendations, not a report of a live test. Sources accessed 10 November 2026.
